method: The full-resolution direct-Rumsey scan was opened in QGIS independently of every neighbouring sheet. Five engraved meridians and two engraved parallels were read and measured at all ten crossings. Roads, rail and industrial marks, shoreline, rivers, lake outlines, geological boundaries, text and the frame were excluded before opposite corner checks were withheld.
qa_review: The top labels read 61d35mW through 61d15mW in five-minute steps. The left labels read 45d30mN and 45d25mN. Full-resolution crops show the thin graticule through mapped land, water, roads, geology and lettering; no coordinate or pixel was copied from the preserved Sheet 24 worktrees or a neighbouring Fletcher sheet.
